### Install
Download **SwitchPeekSetup.exe** below and run it. It installs per-user (no admin rights needed), adds a Start menu shortcut, an *Installed apps* entry for clean uninstall, and optional autostart, then starts SwitchPeek right away. Running it over an existing installation updates it in place.

Requires Windows 10 or 11. Nothing else to install: SwitchPeek runs on .NET Framework 4.0+, which ships with every Windows 10 (4.6+) and Windows 11 (4.8+).

> Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unrecognized app because the installer is not code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
